findings.title: Run-ID not wired to commit pathway
findings.description: format_commit_message() is defined and tested in isolation, but no production code calls it. The repair_implementer tracks commit SHAs but doesn't create commits with formatted messages.
findings.action: Add a call to format_commit_message() at the commit point (likely in repair_implementer or a commit coordination layer), passing the run_id from context and using the returned string as the commit message.
